# Chain stream_bzip2 and stream_tar over a .tar.bz2 of bzip2 NDJSON files.
#
# The archive holds three entries, in this order:
#
#   d/             directory (not counted by stream_tar)
#   d/m1.json.bz2  regular file, index 0: {"a":1} and {"b":2}
#   d/m2.json.bz2  regular file, index 1: {"c":3}
#
# Each file is itself bzip2 compressed, hence the second stream_bzip2.
base64 hourly.base64 hourly.tar.bz2

mito -use file,json,stream,try src.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want.txt

-- src.cel --
{
	"all":   file('hourly.tar.bz2').stream_bzip2().stream_tar().stream_bzip2().decode_json_stream_lazy().map(x, x),
	"entry": file('hourly.tar.bz2').stream_bzip2().stream_tar(1).stream_bzip2().decode_json_stream_lazy().map(x, x),
	"range": try(file('hourly.tar.bz2').stream_bzip2().stream_tar(2).decode_json_stream_lazy().map(x, x)),

	// The bzip2 header is checked when the stream is created.
	"bad_header":   try(b"not bzip2".stream_bzip2()),
	"short_header": try(b"BZ".stream_bzip2()),
	"empty":        try(b"".stream_bzip2()),
}
-- hourly.base64 --

-- want.txt --
{
	"all": [
		{
			"a": 1
		},
		{
			"b": 2
		},
		{
			"c": 3
		}
	],
	"bad_header": "stream_bzip2: bzip2 data invalid: bad magic value",
	"empty": "stream_bzip2: reading header: unexpected EOF",
	"entry": [
		{
			"c": 3
		}
	],
	"range": "stream_tar: index 2 out of range [0, 2)",
	"short_header": "stream_bzip2: reading header: unexpected EOF"
}
